claims.assertion: Mari says astral parasites attach through vibrational compatibility, often linked to persistent low emotions and destructive thought patterns.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as her account of attachment.

claims.assertion: She recommends meditation, thought control, music, water, wind, herbs, and crystals to remove or deter such entities.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says meditation and emotional self-control are most effective.

claims.assertion: Mari describes parasitic entities as physical egregors sustained by repetitive thought and attention; interrupting those patterns can end their influence.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says they depend on attention from people strongly connected to Source.
